item.title: The pavement is blocked, 18th August
item.description:
This overgrowth is completely blocking the pavement. It is reported frequently and then marked as dealt with... because the council simply pushes the problem onto UK power network. But they clearly don't who don't care and do nothing time after time. It's the councils responsibility to keep the highways and pavements clear for its residents. Under Section 154 of the Highways Act 1980, local councils can order owners to cut back overgrown vegetation within 14 days, and bill them if the council has to do the work instead. Given that ordering the landowners has clearly and repeatedly not worked, stop ignoring the problem. take some responsibility and support the local tax paying residents and get this fixed... and reclaim the costs if you need too. Be the council we voted for please

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 30, Crofton Avenue, Albany Park, Greater London
